title: Add private-safe conversation checkpoints to the CYAxiverse Project

body_extracts.objective: Add a privacy-safe way to surface durable outcomes from exploratory AI/chat investigations in the existing CYAxiverse Research & Development GitHub Project without making GitHub an index or archive of private conversations.
body_extracts.project_model: A later Research & Chats saved view should show these durable investigation/checkpoint Issues using the same Status field.
body_extracts.acceptance: A Research & Chats Project view can be created from the defined durable-item convention without creating a second project ledger.

comments.author: vmmhep
comments.heading: CYAX-0155 implementation update
comments.implementation_statement: Privacy-rule implementation is complete and merged via PR #156. The repository-side privacy boundary is therefore active on vmm.
comments.remaining_project_action: Keep #155 open until the Research & Chats saved Project view/filter is configured.
comments.tooling_limit: The current GitHub connector does not expose Projects-v2 view/field mutations, and current plugin discovery found no alternative Projects-specific connector, so this comment does not falsely claim that UI configuration is complete.
comments.verification_limit: The existing G2 auto-add workflow is expected to add matching open Issues such as #155 to Backlog; that Project-side result cannot be directly verified from the current connector.
